items.example: Bad weather accounts for most of the delays.
items.simple: To be the reason for something, or to be a part of a whole.
items.note: İki anlam: neden olmak / pay oluşturmak.

items.example: Don't bank on getting a pay rise this year.
items.simple: You trust that something will happen and you plan for it.

items.example: She bounced back quickly after the illness.
items.simple: After a bad time, you become strong and happy again.

items.example: He brushed aside all my concerns.
items.simple: You do not listen to something because you think it is small.

items.example: We all chipped in to buy her a gift.
items.exampleTr: Ona hediye almak için hepimiz para verdik.
items.simple: Each person gives a little money or help to do something together.

items.example: The council is clamping down on illegal parking.
items.exampleTr: Belediye kaçak parka karşı sıkı önlem alıyor.
items.simple: Leaders make strict rules to stop a bad thing.

items.example: The meeting dragged on for hours.
items.simple: It lasts too long and gets boring.

items.example: Try not to dwell on the past.
items.simple: You keep thinking about something again and again.

items.example: She fended off the reporters' questions.
items.simple: You keep something or someone away from you.

items.example: He glossed over the details of the deal.
items.simple: You talk about something quickly so no one notices the hard parts.

items.example: The whole plan hinges on his decision.
items.simple: Everything depends on one important thing, like a door on its hinge.

items.example: We still need to iron out a few problems.
items.simple: You fix small problems until all is smooth.

items.example: He lashed out at her in front of everyone.
items.simple: You say or do something very angry to someone, fast.

items.example: He backed out of the deal at the last minute.
items.simple: You said yes, but then you do not do it.

items.example: Lots of shops cash in on the holiday rush.
items.exampleTr: Pek çok dükkan tatil kalabalığından kâr sağlıyor.
items.simple: You use a good chance to make money.

items.example: I was going to jump, but I chickened out.
items.simple: You plan to do something brave, but then you are too scared.

items.example: It all comes down to money in the end.
items.simple: The most important thing, after you think about everything.

items.example: The police are cracking down on speeding.
items.exampleTr: Polis hız yapmaya karşı sert önlem alıyor.
items.simple: People in charge get strict about a bad thing.

items.tr: aklına dank etmek, birden fark etmek
items.example: It suddenly dawned on me that I'd left the oven on.
items.exampleTr: Birden fırını açık bıraktığım aklıma dank etti.
items.simple: You suddenly understand something you did not see before.

items.example: We waited until the noise died down.
items.simple: Something gets less and less strong until it stops.

items.example: We had to dip into our savings to fix the roof.
items.exampleTr: Çatıyı onarmak için birikimimize el atmak zorunda kaldık.
items.simple: You take a little bit from something that you keep.

items.example: I had to fork out £200 for a new tyre.
items.exampleTr: Yeni bir lastik için istemeye istemeye 200 sterlin ödemek zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: You must pay a lot of money, and you do not like it.

items.example: I still haven't got around to replying to him.
items.exampleTr: Hâlâ ona cevap yazmaya vakit bulamadım.
items.simple: You finally find time to do something you wanted to do.

items.example: Let's hold off on buying anything until Monday.
items.exampleTr: Pazartesiye kadar bir şey almayı erteleyelim.
items.simple: You wait and do not do it yet.

items.example: Let me jot down your number before I forget.
items.exampleTr: Unutmadan numaranı bir yere not edeyim.
items.simple: You write something very fast, in a short way.

items.example: The festival kicks off on Friday evening.
items.simple: Something starts, like a football game begins.

items.example: She never let on that she knew about the party.
items.exampleTr: Parti hakkında bildiğini hiç belli etmedi.
items.simple: You tell a secret you were keeping, without meaning to.

items.example: Come on, lighten up! It's just a game.
items.exampleTr: Hadi ama, rahatla! Sadece bir oyun.
items.simple: You stop being so serious and have some fun.
